notes.title: 2024/4/13 Update【ver_1.1.8】
notes.content:
2024/4/13 Update
【ver_1.1.8】
*Optimized two model collisions
*Improved controller support (using the controller to operate menus and play the game).
*In-game button tips will be automatically switched according to the playing device.
*Optimized the feel of controller gameplay.
*Press [View button] to view the Controller layout at any time.

notes.title: 2024/4/9 Update【ver_1.1.5】
notes.content:
2024/4/9 Update
【ver_1.1.5】
*Tried to fix the problem that "the tip ui of the interaction key E could not be displayed in uncertain situations".
*Fixed the issue of "Landline phone can not be interacted in the late flow".

notes.title: 2024/4/7 Update【ver_1.1.4】
notes.content:
2024/4/7 Update
【ver_1.1.4】
*Fixed the issue of "When multiple buttons are pressed in the elevator, the elevator door will not be able to stop when it is opened after reaching the floor (it will continue to run to the next target floor and an elevator door error occurs)".

notes.title: 2024/4/7 Update【ver_1.1.3】
notes.content:
2024/4/7 Update
【ver_1.1.3】
*Fixed the issue where, when the elevator door is blocked, calling the elevator from other floors would result in the elevator door failing to close properly.

notes.title: 2024/4/7 Update【ver_1.1.2】
notes.content:
2024/4/7 Update
【ver_1.1.2】
*Fixed the issue that "players could enter rooms that they should not be able to enter during certain flows".
*Fixed the issue where players would get stuck out of the map due to the elevator door, now players will block the elevator door from closing.

notes.title: 2024/4/5 Update【ver_1.1.0】
notes.content:
2024/4/5 Update
【ver_1.1.0】
* English localization improved, now it's basically comprehensive.
*"Back to main menu" and "Quit" options have been added in the settings.
